_readme: E&M works of a sewage pumping station in the sewer DPR (dpr_em.py) - user decisions 26-Oct-2026: the format of the U.P. Jal Nigam E&M estimate 'R2 DISTRICT-Elmwood ZONE VNS SENDED TO cd.xls' (Construction Division E/M, Springfield); pumps for the +15 years peak of the design (CPHEEO Table 2.1 p2-9); a size the estimate has no rate for: its rate x (size / size there)^exponent (exponent fitted on the estimate's sizes, or assumed - 'src' says which); screens, automation, tools, lighting, safety and the 11 kV line as in the estimate for every station. Everything here is yellow in the workbook, to be confirmed.

sizing.src: R2 'Revise c': BHP = Q (LPM) x H x 1.05 / 4500; 95 % of the rated discharge in parallel; head = civil head + 3 m E/M head (entry, pump, column pipe); non-peak flow 0.5 x average on one small pump (1 W + 1 S), the rest on 2 working + 2 standby big pumps; load = motors x 0.746 / 0.8 + 15 kVA miscellaneous; DG and transformer for 1.2 x load (DG also for the starting current, 2nd pump on soft starter 1.5 x); transformers 1 W + 1 S; column pipe 1.6 m/s, header 1.4 m/s; pump cable: current / 0.87 x 2.5 (what gives the estimate's 6 and 16 sq mm for 10 and 20 HP), 75 m a pump (R2 300 m for 4 pumps)

efficiency.src: R2 'Revise c' K53:N57: pump efficiency by discharge (LPM): < 400 0.67, 400-700 0.70, 700-1900 0.72, above 0.85

margin.src: R2 'Revise c' K46:N51: margin on the motor by kW: up to 1.5 kW 50 %, 1.5-3.7 40 %, 3.7-7.5 30 %, 7.5-15 20 %, 15-75 15 %, above 75 kW 10 %

pipe_mm.src: commercial DI / CI pipe and valve sizes (mm)

cable_sqmm.src: copper XLPE armoured cable, current rating in air (A) - approximate catalogue values

pump.text: Submersible sewage non-clog pump set with jacket-cooled integrated motor, guide rail / auto-coupling, guide pipe and chain
pump.src: R2 Pumping Plants B8 (DJB 2.2.5, 20 HP) and B13 (237653, 10 HP): exponent fitted

soft.text: Soft starter (fitted in the L.T. panel)
soft.src: R2 Pumping Plants B5 (20 HP) and B10 (60000, 10 HP)

capacitor.text: Shunt type power factor improvement capacitor
capacitor.src: R2 Pumping Plants B19 (DJB 14.1.4) at the R2 load 61.62 kVA; kVAr in proportion to the load

mov.text: Motor operated sluice valve with actuator, CIDF
mov.src: R2 Pumping Plants B25:B27 (100 / 150 mm 125000, 250 mm 190000): exponent fitted

specials.text: CIDF specials (tees, bends, duck-foot bends, reducers, blind flanges)
specials.src: R2 Pumping Plants B36: 5400 kg at Rs 130 for 6 pumps and a 250 mm header

bolts.src: R2 Pumping Plants B45: 900 kg at Rs 300

flowmeter.text: Electromagnetic flow meter with CVT and control cables
flowmeter.src: R2 Pumping Plants B50:B51 (225000 + 20000, 250 mm); exponent assumed

pumpcable.src: R2 Pumping Plants B94:B95 (Havells 2025: 3.5C x 6 sq mm 1100, 4C x 16 sq mm 2100 per m)

dg.text: DG set, 1500 RPM, acoustic enclosure, AMF panel, control panel
dg.src: R2 DG B11 (UPJN, 62.5 kVA); exponent assumed (0.6 rule)

transformer.src: R2 Sub Station B8 (UPJN, 100 kVA); exponent assumed

ltpanel.text: L.T. panel, CRCA, factory wired, incomer / outgoing MCCBs, bus coupler
ltpanel.src: R2 Panel B5 (DJB 10.1.2) at the R2 load 61.62 kVA

ltcable.text: Power cable 1.1 kV (transformer to L.T. panel)
ltcable.src: R2 Panel B26 (300 m) at the R2 incomer 139 A

rates.src: rate of the item at 'size' in the R2 estimate; another size: rate x (size / that size)^exp

pumping: Necessary piping, pump set foundation, rubber packing, insertion etc.
3 T mono rail single girder lifting tackle
Tools & plants (meggers, crimping tools, multimeter, wrenches, spanners etc.)
Fire extinguishers, rubber sheets, steel chairs, fire bucket, almirahs, table
Installation & commissioning of pump sets, piping & valves
Painting of pumps, piping and valves
Light wiring, fittings, LED fixtures and 9 m poles
Double earthing of the pumping plant
Safety equipment (helmets, gas detectors, harness etc.)
screens: SS 316 mechanical coarse bar screen with conveyor, panel
CI thimble mounted sluice gate with motor actuator
Installation & commissioning of screens and gates
automation: GPRS/GSM redundant RTU with CPU, I/O
lt_other: Erection of L.T. panels, cables, trenches
Testing of L.T. panels at manufacturer's works
ht: 11 kV XLPE 3 x 35 sq mm cable, 150 m
Double earthing of sub-station equipment (12 pits)
Internal electrification of H.T. / L.T. rooms
MS chequered plates over cable trenches
Barbed wire fencing of switch yard

fixed.src: R2 Pumping Plants rows 48-99, Screens, DG, Automation, Panel, Sub Station, Power Connection, Trial Run - the same for every station (user decision 26-Oct-2026); per pump where the estimate has one a pump; DG diesel 10 l/h for 125 kVA = 0.08 l/kVA/h
